_help: Add one entry per website. The agent only works on entries with approved: true and a repo it can access. Backlog: top item is done first.

sites.type: static HTML on Vercel; text in content.js, prices in config.js; index.html (English) and ur/index.html (Roman Urdu, fully generated — never edit by hand) hold pre-rendered copies made by seo-agent/tools/prerender.js (re-run after any change to content.js or config.js)
sites.business: Webxeen: AI WhatsApp sales assistant for small businesses. Answers customers 24/7 in 8 languages (Urdu, Roman Urdu, English, Arabic, Farsi, Spanish, Hindi, Italian), takes orders with receipts, checks payment screenshots, seller controls everything from WhatsApp.
sites.audience: Worldwide. Small businesses anywhere that sell or take bookings on WhatsApp: online shops, clothing brands, restaurants, clinics, salons, Instagram/Facebook sellers. Strong home markets: Pakistan, the Gulf (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), UK and Europe; also India, Africa, Latin America and South-East Asia where WhatsApp is the main way to buy.
sites.facts_source: content.js and config.js in the repo are the only source of product facts and prices.

target_markets.goal: Rank worldwide, not only in Pakistan. Pakistan is one market among many.
rules: Global pages are written for an international reader: USD prices, generic payment wording (bank transfer, card, cash on delivery, mobile wallets), examples from several countries. Pakistan-specific details (JazzCash, PKR, Lahore) go only on Pakistan-focused pages.
Use the product's real 8-language support as the main global advantage: build real localized pages (Arabic, Spanish first) on their own URLs with hreflang and x-default.

Prefer long-tail, use-case and language-specific keywords (e.g. 'WhatsApp order bot for restaurants', 'bot de WhatsApp para tiendas', 'بوت واتساب للمتاجر') over head terms dominated by large global companies.
Never claim global customers, countries served or numbers that are not in the facts source.
